services.label: External attack surface

services.label: External DNS · Cloudflare
services.description: Public DNS observations only. No account access, token storage, ownership assertion, or hosted DNS writes.

services.label: Platform Key Vault
services.description: Resource metadata only. The console never reads or edits platform secrets.

services.label: PawPrint portal / API
services.description: Existing Static Web App and linked Functions. API health is separate from Azure resource availability.

services.label: Pawton
services.description: Training workload. Workflow results are not live health. Doctor can invoke a write-capable Defender posture audit; use the protected workflow.

services.label: PHP cloud defense dojo
services.description: Training workload with explicit subscription and lab suffix requirements. No hosted deploy, paid protection or DNS actions.

services.label: Code-to-Cloud security dojo
services.description: Status and protected workflow links only. Builds, cost gates and reviewed release confirmations are not bypassed.
